subject: maths
question: A 325 m long train overtakes a man moving at a speed of 5 km/hr (in the same direction) in 45 seconds. How much time (in seconds) will it take this train to completely cross another 440 m long train, moving in the opposite direction at a speed of 20 km/hr?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of first train = 325

Speed of man = 5 km/hr

Time to overtake man = 45 seconds

Length of second train = 440

Speed of second train = 20 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Relative speed = Sum or difference of speeds

1 km/hr = 5 ÷ 18 m/s

**Calculation:**

⇒ Relative speed with man = 325 ÷ 45

⇒ = 65 ÷ 9
